[Reading] MC Rote = Em-See Rote (Mile Championship Rotation)

■Stage Direction
1 sec silence at start
She is completely getting into character as young Gimlet from that day

Swiftly, and powerfully. To shine with dazzling brilliance in a fleeting instant.
It was a glory that matched the very aesthetic she proclaimed.
Then await another spoonful of gin...!
And he added this:

Which is why racing was always so close to me since childhood.
The unrivaled "speed" to leave all others behind, the "strength" to conquer the race—

It seemed Tanino Gimlet had orchestrated this whole thing.
Perhaps I might find out what came next in that journal.

Swap the vodka base for brandy, and it becomes a Sidecar; use gin,
and it is a White Lady; tequila makes it a Margarita—

Yet... hmph.
In that recent mile race, the goddess of fortune refused to smile upon me.

Now, let us return to the tale.
Indeed, the revelation from my father was that very sacred cocktail—

—...In other words, from that day forth,
I honed my strength and speed with that dazzling, fleeting brilliance as my base.

"While there is beauty in shining long and enduring, there is also beauty in blazing for a fleeting instant to leave a deep scar.
The world loves a lasting light, but only the fleeting spark scorches the soul."

When I arrived at the bar & restaurant,
for some reason, the bartender presented me with a complimentary cocktail.
I shall carve it deep into this world...!

With speed and strength, blazing brilliantly in an instant!
A myth etched upon eyes, mind, heart, past, and future...!
...As I wrestled with that question, my father taught me of a certain cocktail—

Foolishness; "what-ifs" are strictly forbidden in battle.
Yet... yes. This is a scenario of possibilities.

And my mother, just like us,
was a warrior who staked her life upon the Twinkle Series.

Upon enrolling, destiny brought me face-to-face with it.
I knew with absolute certainty: I am the chosen assassin meant to achieve it first!
With that, Tanino Gimlet pointed toward the glass in her hand.
...A fleeting spark that scorches the soul...?

"They asked me to ensure you take a sip.
...From a rather eccentric member of our staff."

A 2,400-meter race held with scarcely any respite after a mile race.
This means—

I must determine my base.
What is it that I wish to achieve as myself...?

In other words, no matter how much sweetness and sourness of "be swift" and "be strong"
you shake together, that alone will never complete it.

"The Gimlet is an exquisite drink that strikes fiercely in an instant,
leaving one yearning for its aftertaste."

I need nothing else!
A burning scar deeper than any prison—I, and I alone, shall carve it...!

That is the very self I seek!
With the Gimlet, the raison d'être of 'Tanino Gimlet' begins!

My father was a bartender, often practicing at home. So
even though I had never tasted alcohol, cocktails were always familiar to me.

Be swift, be strong—that is the supreme aesthetic.
With those two tenets as my compass, I sprinted across the wasteland—until I suddenly realized something.
Now, behold the culmination of our tale.
Being my Trainer, you surely grasp what this means.
The NHK Mile Cup demanding innate speed, and the Japanese Derby demanding total supremacy to crown the generation's strongest—

Unable to resist my burning curiosity, I made my way toward that bar & restaurant—
presumably "the bar" mentioned in the note.
"Want to hear the rest? You know the bar."

Whether or not I possess the potential to conquer the MC Rotation
in the Twinkle Series. —You wish to know the answer, do you not?

This is almost identical to the rotation concept being talked about recently,
challenging from a Mile to Classic distance—the "MC Rotation"!
Since I was too young to drink, my father taught me their flavors through words.

...Heh! Welcome to my world tree.
I knew that once you read it, you would not fail to appear.

It seemed handmade, but spectator tickets were not normally required for mock races.
Perhaps this was part of her theatrical flair... putting that aside for now.
When I nodded firmly without thinking, Tanino Gimlet smirked with deep satisfaction.
I was lacking a "base"...!

Having my heart struck time and again by those sights,
what I dreamed of and yearned for naturally took shape.

A Balalaika takes vodka as its base, shaken with white curaçao
and lemon juice before being poured into the glass to complete it.

It translates to "If you want to hear the rest, come to the usual bar."
Why she chose to write it in English was a mystery, but putting that aside—

Tanino Gimlet flashed a fearless grin at my overwhelmed expression,
then produced a white envelope.

I shall run in the upcoming mock race.
...A race on turf, over 2,400 meters.
The Gimlet!

Obediently taking a sip, I discovered...
it was a cocktail defined by its sharp, crisp bite—indeed—
—Here is a complimentary cocktail for you.

...Guh! Ah, yes! That is it, Father!
Can you hear this racing heartbeat, Father?!

The journal cut off abruptly there...
and in its place was a single memo tucked between the pages.

Opening the envelope handed to me, inside was—
a note inscribed with "Mock Race Spectator Ticket."

...Standard cocktails, as a rule, follow three core elements:
sweetness, sourness, and the liquor that serves as their "base."
A fine drink takes its name and completion from its "base."

"Indeed. If you ask for my thought... for someone fierce and intense like you,
that incandescent brilliance is the very light you yearn to chase, is it not?"
